notes.description: Implementation notes: what changed and why.

tests_expected.description: Tests that should cover this change. MARU Core executes the gate, not you.

blocker.description: Set this, with an empty `changed_files`, instead of reporting work you could not do. Null when there is no blocker.

classification.description: The blocker class. This alone decides routing.

message.description: One sentence a human can act on.

criterion.description: The criterion or project rule this blocker is about, or null.

authority.description: Who holds the authority you lack, e.g. the Constitution rule, or null.
